pages.title: Winner!
pages.text: Winner! plays when you win the championship in Skitchin', and it ends in TV static. The whole game is presented as a show on the Outlaw Sports channel, just as EA Sports games of the time were made to look like TV.

pages.title: The faces on Outlaw Sports
pages.text: Skitchin's TV hosts are The Spectre, Crash Cassidy and Barb Banger. The faces of the hosts and the racers are the team's own, digitized, and designer Dave Warfield is the skater Fester.

pages.title: 78% on average
pages.text: Skitchin' got 47 reviews, with an average score of 78%. EGM's five reviewers gave it between 5 and 7 out of 10, and a German magazine called it "Stitching" by mistake and gave it 47%.
